leadText:
----
 
Jubei (Japanese: ジュウベエ Jūbei) is a character of the day who appeared in Training Daze. 

He was a red team member and Jessie's twelfth partner (tenth in the dub). He shared a with her as well, until they failed a robbing test. This resulted in him getting a poor grade.
